reason: Outcome-first terminal notice, job- and provider-neutral: scheduled runs end with an 'Outcome: <one sentence>' line (prompt guidance), jobOutcomeHeadline lifts it into StructuredJobResult.headline so every native renderer prints the outcome first and the text variant shows it after the header without the duplicate summary. Scope: prompt-profile-service.ts, status-formatting.ts (or rollup), execution-notifications.ts, tests.

quality.summary: Notice leads with the outcome when the run provides one.
